assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and transient neurological deficits consistent with a history of transient ischemic attacks and paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
Given the personal history of TIA and cerebral infarction, prolonged cardiac rhythm monitoring is indicated to detect intermittent arrhythmias that may be contributing to these ischemic events.
Cardiac Event Monitoring (CPT 93271) is therefore medically necessary to identify paroxysmal atrial fibrillation associated with the patient's recurrent neurological symptoms.
The service is Cardiac Event Monitoring (CPT 93271).
The patient has a history of transient ischemic attacks (TIA).
The patient has paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0).
The patient has a personal history of TIA and cerebral infarction (Z86.73).
